important_dates.interview_date: 27 October 2026 (same day after written test results)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the post is 35 years as considered on 01 October 2026.

qualification.details: All educational, professional, and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time.

salary_details.project technical support-iii: Rs 28000+HRA as admissible (consolidated sum without any other benefits)

selection_process: Selection will be carried out in three stages: Document Verification

Stage I: Document Verification: Only eligible candidates shortlisted for the written test. Stage II: Written Test: All eligible applicants take the written test. Stage III: Interview: Only candidates shortlisted in the written test will be eligible to appear for the interview
which is conducted on the same day after the declaration of written test results.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria for the Project Technical Support-III post.
Click on the online application link provided in the official notification.
Fill out the required details to apply online by 17 October 2026.
Download and fill out the prescribed application form (Annexure 1).

Bring the duly filled and signed Application Form (Annexure 1) along with one set of self-attested photocopies of professional qualification certificates, mark sheets, proof of age (10th marks sheet), and experience certificate (if applicable) on the day of the interview.
Ensure all original documents are produced for verification during the Document Verification stage.
important_instructions: Candidates must apply by personally presenting themselves with their application form in the prescribed format and supported documents at the time of interview to Prof. (Dr.) Sanjay Vikrant, HOD-cum-Principal Investigator, Department of Nephrology, AIIMS Bilaspur HP. No admit card or call letter will be issued for the written test and interview. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview, including for SC/ST candidates. The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The post is purely temporary for this project, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Bilaspur. No inquiries shall be entertained after the due date.
